## What changed?

Tell us what this makes possible or what it fixes.

## How did you test it?

Include the commands, example task, screenshots, or other evidence you used.

## Anything reviewers should know?

Call out compatibility changes, new permissions, external side effects, data handling,
or failure cases. Delete this section if there is nothing unusual.

## Before submitting

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] Public English and Chinese documentation still agree, if either changed.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets, private user data, generated runs, or local paths.
